summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute heavily obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: @or-sdk/druid@1.4.8 declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (or reuses a local `bun` binary) and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` on `npm install`. math_init.js is a ~728KB heavily obfuscated file tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`, compiled specifically for the Bun runtime just downloaded. It uses string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shuffling `n7gIxM`), a custom-alphabet string decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and single-letter mangled identifiers. The obfuscated payload is unreferenced by any exported Druid SDK API and is only reachable through the preinstall dropper — the SDK code path itself never loads Bun or math_init.js. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alternate runtime is fetched at install time solely to execute a bundled obfuscated payload under an interpreter that scanners inspecting Node-resolved code do not analyze, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
